summary: This Form 6-K from Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd reports a routine operational update: its Indonesian subsidiary issued two Letters of Award for MEP equipment and installation for Phase 1A of a data center, valued between $65M and $75M. The filing describes infrastructure procurement, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other corporate event is involved. The announcement is forward-looking and subject to construction and financing risks. As such, this is not a special-situation category; it is an ordinary business progress report.
